newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil quiet, Russian pressured.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil quiet, Russian pressured.

text.p: European low sulphur straight-run was quiet on Friday but buyers and sellers moved further apart while Russian high sulphur material was pressured further with improving refiners margins.
Traders said some buyers were at the $104/$105 mark or $1 to $2 lower that Thursday, while sellers were sticking their ground above $110 fob with one at $115.
"I think buyers are $104 and $105 is probably achievable, but the sellers are not below $110 at the moment," a refiner said.
